## Security Checklist

Before merging, confirm:

- [ ] No credentials, access keys, or secrets in any committed file
- [ ] No `*.tfstate` or `*.tfstate.backup` files added
- [ ] No `.env` files added
- [ ] No private SSH keys or certificates added
- [ ] Terraform changes pass `terraform fmt` and `terraform validate`
- [ ] CI checks pass (or failures are documented and accepted)

## Testing

Describe what was tested and how:

- [ ] Terraform validate / plan reviewed
- [ ] Ansible playbook syntax checked
- [ ] Python scripts tested locally
- [ ] Documentation reviewed for accuracy

## Status Labels

Use one of these for each changed component:

- **Implemented and verified** — ran and confirmed working
- **Tested locally (simulated)** — tested in local lab, not cloud
- **Deployed in cloud** — live AWS/Azure/GCP resources (requires approval)
- **Planned** — code written but not yet run
